Scope justifications
Sensitive scopes
Machines & Cloud lets a signed-in business owner connect their primary Google Calendar. calendar.calendars.readonly identifies the connected calendar. calendar.events.owned lets the app create an event for a saved customer visit, then check, reschedule or delete that same event when the owner changes the visit. Read-only event access cannot save changes; calendar.app.created cannot write to the owner's existing primary calendar. The app does not list unrelated events or read free/busy time. Disconnecting stops further sync and removes the stored refresh token; it does not delete events or revoke Google's grant.
